Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

coupling: Two independent composition bugs, on disjoint commits and hunks, so no single edit is reachable as an overflow and dropping any one edit leaves the other bug reachable. Preselection entity ids (5ee7f6c and c443e3b, prsl_box_read in src/isomedia/box_code_base.c): 5ee7f6c accepts an entity-id count up to (payload+3)/4 while the allocation and the store loop still use one u32 per id, so that commit alone stays inside the buffer. c443e3b clamps the allocation to the bytes left in the box. The original size/4 test already guarantees count*4 fits, so the clamp never changes the size and that commit alone stays in bounds. Together a count allowed by the rounded test is written past the clamped allocation (gf_odf_preselection_cfg_parse). Entity-to-group ids (256756b and 9786dd4, grptype_box_read in src/isomedia/iff.c): 256756b reallocates the id array down to the remaining payload only when count*4 exceeds it, a case the original size/4 test rejects before the new code runs, so that commit alone is a no-op on every accepted box. 9786dd4 widens the test to (payload+3)/4 and still allocates count*4 bytes, so the stores stay in the buffer. Together the widened test lets the count through and the realloc shrinks the buffer the loop still indexes by that count (gf_isom_open of a meta/grpl/altr box). Restoring the strict test or the full-size allocation in only one pair removes that pair and leaves the other pair's overflow. The hunks do not share context lines, so each diff applies on the original commit without the other edit.
